finalText: Perfect! All tests are now green. The issue was in the start index calculation on line 7. The function was using `page * perPage` when it should use `(page - 1) * perPage`. Since pages are 1-indexed (page 1 is the first page, not page 0), we need to subtract 1 from the page number to get the correct offset into the array. This fix makes all 5 tests pass.
